At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led an elite '''clone airborne division''' of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] into the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|exterminate]] the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]].

==Description==
Made up of elite [[Clone paratrooper/Legends|clone paratroopers]],<ref name="SW30C" /> a type of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] that specialized in high-altitude drops,<ref name="Sideshow AC">{{SideshowCite|set=Militaries of Star Wars|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=212th Attack Battalion: Utapau (2nd Airborne Company)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/212th_Attack_Battalion_Utapau_Sideshow_Collectibles.asp}}</ref> the [[Division/Legends|division]] was sorted under<ref name="SW30C" /> the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]<ref name="BF II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> and was under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="SW30C" />

At least one member of the division utilized<ref name="SW30C" /> specialized, heavy [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]]<ref name="Sideshow AC" /> with the same [[Color/Legends|blue]] markings as<ref name="SW30C" /> the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of the 501st Legion.<ref name="BF II" /> The trooper was armed with<ref name="SW30C" /> a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] and two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]].<ref name="RotS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], immediately before the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Anakin Skywalker&mdash;now [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader after falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]&mdash;was assigned a detachment of the 501st Legion, to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|exterminate]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] found in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], under the [[Order 66/Legends|orders]] of Vader's new [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="RoTS novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> The division of clone airborne troopers, under the 501st Legion, followed Vader into the [[Jedi temple/Legends|temple]] and [[Death/Legends|eliminated]] the Jedi they could find, sparing none.<ref name="SW30C" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone airborne division was created by [[Hasbro]] as part of their [[2007]] [[Wikipedia:Target|Target]]-exclusive line of ''[[Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection]]'' action figures.<ref name="SW30C" />
